jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Development Strategic Planning  (hybrid)
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid or Onsite

As the Senior Manager, Business Development Strategic Planning, you will play a leadership role in the Instruments Division’s annual strategic planning process by setting vision for the Strat Planning process, managing deliverables, organizing inputs, distilling conclusions for Divisional leadership and tracking progress against agreed upon KPI’s and/or strategic initiatives.

You will act as the strategic facilitator to Division Leaders, help to create clarity around complex problems and long-term strategic objectives. You will analyze data, benchmark best practices, assess possible paths forward and help to present actionable solutions that optimize results across a range of subjects that span the business including market prioritization, organizational design to support long term growth, competency and gap assessment, and resource allocation.

This hybrid role is based out of our Portage, MI office.

What you will do
- Analyze complex business problems using strategic frameworks, data, and an inquisitive mindset to identify opportunities and clarify current-state challenges.
- Source, model, and interpret data from internal and external sources, simplifying complex information into actionable insights for decision-makers.
- Develop and evaluate strategic options through research, benchmarking, stakeholder interviews, and critical thinking, while considering trade-offs, resources, and organizational capabilities.
- Partner with cross-functional teams and senior leaders to communicate recommendations, build alignment, and support data-driven decision-making.
- Assess financial implications of strategic recommendations within the context of a complex P&L and help leaders understand potential business impacts.
- Drive strategy implementation and accountability by establishing tracking processes, scorecards, and metrics to monitor progress and results.
- Lead the annual strategic planning process, coordinating timelines, deliverables, frameworks, and contributors across a highly matrixed organization.
- Lead and develop people and external partners, including mentoring analytical professionals, building cross-divisional relationships, and managing external consultants and research firms.

What you need
Required:

- Bachelor’s degree
- Minimum 10 years of work experience
- Demonstrated strong presentation skills and executive communication capabilities
- Ability to effectively communicate and influence business leaders across varying levels of experience and expertise

Preferred:
- MBA
- Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, corporate development, strategy, MedTech Marketing, Private Equity or MedTech Investment Banking
- Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience with P&L management and financial analysis
- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting established timelines and deliverables
- Ability to navigate and operate effectively within complex interdivisional processes, procedures, and policies
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

jobs.title: Lead Analyst, Treasury EU Core Operations
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

The Lead Analyst, Treasury EMEA CORE Operations is an individual contributor role responsible for treasury core operations across the EMEA region, operating within a varied banking environment spanning multiple entities, countries, and banking partners. In this role, you will lead end-to-end bank account lifecycle activities, KYC compliance, and M&A-related treasury work across EMEA.
Please note this is a 12 month contract role.

Key Responsibilities
- Regional Bank Account Governance

You lead the bank account lifecycle across EMEA, including account openings and closures, KYC refreshes, signatory updates, and banking resolution implementation, ensuring structured execution and timely delivery, while maintaining oversight of progress, dependencies, and risks across activities.
- M&A and Structural Changes

You lead and drive banking-related activities for structural changes, newly acquired entities, transitions, integrations, KYC updates, and signatory structures across multiple jurisdictions. These activities are often carried out under challenging timelines and involve unfamiliar stakeholders, diverse local processes, varying banking requirements, and a high degree of uncertainty. You assess changing circumstances, identify risks, evaluate options, determine practical solutions, and drive activities through to completion while maintaining control and business continuity.
- Process Improvement and Operational Efficiency

You lead improvements in treasury operations by strengthening tracking, improving KPI visibility, and identifying opportunities to simplify work and reduce manual effort. You drive initiatives such as process standardization, account rationalization, system and bank integrations, bank connectivity, and automation of payment file and bank statement processes. You ensure these improvements support operational needs, controls, and timely execution.
- Execution Oversight and Stakeholder Alignment

Success in this role requires navigating time-sensitive topics across multiple stakeholders, banking partners, and jurisdictions. Activities frequently involve unfamiliar processes, varying banking requirements, changing circumstances, and competing priorities that require careful coordination and follow-through. With no single approach applying to all situations, the role involves assessing issues, identifying risks and dependencies, evaluating options, and determining practical solutions.
- Effective collaboration

Effective collaboration across Treasury, Finance, Legal, HR, IT, business stakeholders, and banking partners is essential to help move activities forward and support timely delivery.

Required
- 5+ years of treasury operations experience in a multinational environment
- Strong expertise in bank account management, KYC/AML, and documentation
- Experience supporting M&A-related banking integration activities
- Solid understanding of multi-country banking environments
- Fluent in English (written and spoken
- Able to structure, organize, and manage work across multiple stakeholders while balancing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Analytical, well organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to assess non-standard issues, identify risks, and define and drive practical solutions.
- Strong working knowledge of treasury systems and banking platforms, including ERP systems and related banking processes; exposure to bank connectivity, XML payment file setup, and statement integration.
- Comfortable working independently with a high degree of autonomy, while effectively collaborating with stakeholders across functions and banking partners to maintain alignment and progress.
- Strong understanding of banking documentation, KYC, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
- Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to adjust approach based on changing priorities, stakeholder needs, and varying banking requirements.

Preferred
- Additional languages across EMEA are a plus.

Why Join Us
Join a collaborative treasury team where your work directly supports international operations across EMEA. You will gain exposure to a wide range of banking, regulatory, and treasury topics while working with colleagues, banking partners, and stakeholders across multiple countries. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to international growth, M&A activities, and business transformation in a dynamic environment that values teamwork, flexibility, and continuous learning.
